July 6 start is fine from the team side. We'd prefer to keep the standard 1-year cliff and 4-year vesting schedule; that's what we budgeted into the offer. Priya's request for partial acceleration isn't something we typically do at initial hire, but we can offer an early performance review at the 6-month mark with a potential refresh if performance/outcomes are strong.
